name: asbuilt
description: Check what your website actually does: turn your intent into approved checks and get Pass, Fail or Not verified with screenshots on every pull request.

interface.longDescription: AsBuilt checks whether your website does what you meant to build. Your assistant reads your code and lists every feature in plain words; you correct the list and approve checks, so you never have to remember every feature yourself. A free GitHub Action then opens each preview deployment in a real browser on desktop and mobile and posts one pull request comment: Pass, Fail or Not verified for each check, with screenshots, coverage of your feature list, and a fix prompt to paste back. On a test site you approve, it can also run your full order flow with test accounts and Stripe's test card. Free and open source. No account, no hosted service, no telemetry. Installing the plugin never starts a test, and nothing is committed without your permission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AsBuilt to turn my intended website behavior into checks. Show me the target and plan before running anything.
